chapter: Later years and the Texas scene
title: Breaking up the band and civil service
summary: The band broke up once, was revived with Chauncey Holland's backing, and ended in 1940 when Albert went into civil service.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money
story.community_name: Quitting the band: why sidemen left

blocks.x: How many times did your band break up? One time.

Only one time it really broke up. It really broke up. That was here when I just got tired. Being in just Jit by everybody and I pulled a bus up here on Euro Street where my wife was born. And that's where this Chauncey Holland came and asked me to revive my band and he got to binge it for you to finance it. And that was the only time until I actually gave it up in 1940. Maybe it was another mistake. Because two years later, well possibly not two years, there was another boom come up. Con Basis stayed in so for me. He just remained with his big band. And I went into civil service. And that's where I've been sentenced. Are you asking me something about Fats Martin? Or have you ever talked about it?
